notes.title: Compete in the Ultimate Puzzle Match in Puyo Puyo™ Tetris® 2, available today!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce [i]Puyo Puyo™ Tetris® 2[/i] is now available to purchase on Steam. This exciting action puzzle experience provides a variety of ways for players to showcase their skills, including a multitude of free content that has been added since the console launch last December. 

Steam users will be able to enjoy a slew of flashy features, including:
[list]
[*] An absolutely packed roster of [b]40 playable characters[/b], including the beloved Sonic the Hedgehog, each with their own unique stats and abilities you can carry with you to the robust, RPG-inspired [b]Skill Battle[/b] mode
[*] A variety of different modes supporting traditional and re-imagined ways to play the iconic puzzle games, such as Swap mode and Party mode
[*] An extensive [b]Adventure[/b] mode, featuring a brand-new story that brings together the game’s vibrant cast for endless exploration in overworld maps
[*] A bounty of competitive [b]Online [/b]features, as well as a co-op [b]Boss Raid[/b] mode where you must work together with three players to take down fierce CPU-controlled bosses, and a new [b]Spectator[/b] mode where you can cheer on others battling in Versus and Skill Battle matches
[*] [b]Color vision accessibility features[/b] which include adjustments for color saturation that can be toggled on or off throughout the game
[*] And much, [b]much[/b] more!
[/list]
[b]Limited-time Steam Launch Edition
[/b]
Steam players can also take advantage of the limited-time [b]Steam Launch Edition[/b]! Boost your strategy and give your team a power-up in [i]Puyo Puyo Tetris 2[/i]’s newly added Boss Raid mode or in Skill Battle mode with this pack of rare Item Cards--including three special cards featuring items from the Sonic the Hedgehog series!

[previewyoutube=30pjFGa9GA8;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Puyo Puyo Tetris 2[/i] is now available to purchase for $29.99 on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1259790/Puyo_Puyo_Tetris_2/]Steam store page[/url]. For more information, be sure to visit the official website at https://puyo.sega.com/tetris2, and stay tuned to the official Puyo Puyo accounts on [url=https://twitter.com/puyoofficial]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/PuyoOfficial]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/puyoofficial/]Instagram[/url] for all the latest.

notes.title: PATCH 4 -- GARBAGE CLEAR!
notes.notes:
Hi Puyo Puyo Tetris fans,

More fixes and tweaks incoming:

•         Tweaked the matchmaking system to find more potential player matches. This should help players find matches closer to their rank level, and avoid new players only matching with high level players. 
•         Fixed a crash when attempting to use menus in a lobby after failing to join correctly. 
•         Fix for rank scores being reset in the event that a leaderboard write fails to take place.  

Thanks, and enjoy!

notes.title: PATCH 3 -- CLEAR! 26 MARCH 2018
notes.notes:
Hi Puyo Puyo Tetris fans,

We’ve got some more audio bug fixes for you:

•	Fixed loop points in specific BGM .
•	Fixed Swap Mode roulette audio.
•	Fixed some incorrect BGM.
•	Arle’s English VO #4 and #5 are no longer switched around.
•	Fixed Amitie’s “It’s Tetris!” VO.
•	Fixed JP Manzai voices for 7_1_2.

For those who are worried your scores are lost from the leaderboards, it appears that the score might not be correctly displayed in the Puzzle League screen in some circumstances. Relaunching the game should restore it. 

If that doesn’t work, please contact SEGA Customer Service:
https://support.sega.co.uk

Thank you!

notes.title: PATCH 2 HARD DROPS! 15 MARCH 2018
notes.notes:
Hi Puyo Puyo Tetris fans,

Thanks for your infinite patience as we brush the game’s teeth and comb its hair.

Patch 2 Notes:
•	Background music now loops correctly.
•	Added additional checks to prevent online Ranking scores from being overwritten.
•	Volume levels are now balanced correctly.
•	Fixed Maguro’s Alternate Japanese VO.
•	Fixed Amitie’s Alternate Japanese VO.
•	Fixed Zed’s robotic voice filter.
•	Fixed missing/incorrect in-game VO in some circumstances.
•	VO language select now applies immediately.
•	Fixed an uncommon audio crash.
•	Fixed an issue with audio volumes after returning focus to the game.
•	Fixed an issue where music would be missing in long games/Big Bang mode.
•	Added clarification text in Graphics menu screen.

Cheers!

notes.title: PATCH 1 IS LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hi Puyo Puyo Tetris fans!

A big shout-out to the Puyo Puyo Tetris community for helping us out in the Steam Discussions. 

Patch 1 Notes:

- Filters now filter out Puzzle League modes correctly.

- Net speed filter is more lenient, and will allow players to find more matches globally if set to No Filter.

- Puzzle League matchmaking will favour rank compatibility over distance.

- Display for number of players is fixed in Freeplay lobby search screens.

- Fix for slowdown on trophy screen.

We’re continuing to work on other fixes, so stay tuned for more news.

Thanks!

notes.title: Puyo Puyo Tetris confirmed for PC, release date set
notes.notes:
Having reported on Overwatch's infiltration of Doom just yesterday, this is becoming quite the week for videogame crossovers. After a flurry of not-very-subtle teasing yesterday, Sega has now confirmed Sonic Team's Puyo Puyo Tetris is coming to PC later this month. 

If you visited Bayonetta or Binary Domain's Steam feeds yesterday, this news probably won't come as a surprise—however Puyo Puyo Tetris' desktop variation promises scalable resolutions, fully customisable controls and mouse-driven menus. With this, Vanquish, Valkyria Chronicles and, of course, Bayonetta, Sega is building a solid reputation for crowd-pleasing console-to-PC ports.

Here's a look at what to expect here:

And here's Sega if you prefer the written word:

Puyo Puyo Tetris sees two puzzle game juggernauts collide as Tetris, one of the top selling video games of all time and one of the most recognised brands in gaming history, and Puyo Puyo from SEGA combine to create a fun-to-play, fast-paced, competitive party game like no other! There are a ton of different styles of gameplay—from the single-player Adventure and Challenge modes to the ferocious competition of the up-to-four-player Arcade modes. 

You can even take your puzzle skills online in the Puzzle League or Free Play multiplayer modes with up to four players. Play through Adventure mode to unlock new characters and backgrounds, and visit the in-game Shop which enables players to unlock new character voices and skins for Puyos and Tetriminos. 

After slagging it off yesterday, I rewatched part of the Magnum PI/Murder She Wrote crossover last night and it's even worse than I remember. Having played and enjoyed Puyo Puyo Tetris on PlayStation 4 last year, though, I can assure you this retro mashup is more worthy of your time.

Puyo Puyo Tetris is due on PC via Steam February 27.
